next_actions: sample common numerical parameters from accepted-sample quantile priors

scalar_family_learning.principle: same metrics and soft scoring are applied to none, phi1_only, phi2_only, and both; no scalar family is banned from exploration

correction_mode_learning.note: Weights are learned softly from accepted current-loop parameter samples. The sampler still applies min_mode_probability floors from config_p.py.

joint_parameter_prior.notes: This memory stores sample-level parameter vectors grouped by theory identity. Sampling uses positive-reward vectors first and falls back to ordinary priors when a matching group has no positive current-loop evidence.
